title: Pied Piper | Social Media Music App

details.headline: Optimizing MongoDB for Real-Time Recommendations
details.problem: The initial architecture for the music recommendation feed suffered from severe latency issues. Inefficient database schema design and a lack of indexing caused slow queries, resulting in a poor user experience and excessive load on the AWS infrastructure.
details.solution: As Backend Lead, I redesigned the MongoDB schema to optimize for read-heavy operations, utilizing denormalization and implementing strategic indexing on key fields. I also integrated AWS Personalize for ML-driven recommendations and used AWS CloudWatch to monitor and validate performance improvements.

impact.text: Decrease in overall API query latency
API availability maintained during peak loads
